info.title: WeatherAPI.com
info.description:
WeatherAPI.com provides real-time, forecast, historical, marine, future, solar PV energy, astronomy, air quality, pollen, sports, IP lookup, timezone, and geolocation data via a JSON/XML REST API. Trusted by 1M+ users worldwide. Average response time ~200ms.

## Authentication
All endpoints require an API key passed as the `key` query parameter.

## Base URL
`https://api.weatherapi.com/v1`

## Location Query (`q` parameter)
Accepts: city name, lat/lon decimal, US zip, UK postcode, Canada postal code, METAR code (`metar:EGLL`), IATA airport code (`iata:DXB`), IP lookup (`auto:ip`), IPv4/IPv6 address, or location ID (`id:2801268`).

## Plans
- **Free**: 100K calls/month, 3-day forecast, 1-day history
- **Starter**: $7/mo — 3M calls, 7-day forecast, 7-day history
- **Pro+**: $25/mo — 5M calls, 300-day future, 365-day history
- **Business**: $65/mo — 10M calls, evapotranspiration
- **Enterprise**: Custom — 15-min interval, pollen history, wind@100m, SLA

get.description: Returns up-to-date current weather for a given location. Data is refreshed every 10–15 minutes. Optionally includes air quality (AQI) and pollen data.

post.description: Retrieve current weather for multiple locations in a single request. Pass `q=bulk` in the query string with a JSON body containing up to 50 locations. Each location counts as 1 call. Available on Pro+, Business, and Enterprise plans.

get.description: Returns weather forecast for up to 14 days (plan dependent). Includes hourly intervals, astronomy, air quality, pollen, and weather alerts.
Returns historical weather data for a given date on or after 1 January 2010. Includes hourly breakdown. Enterprise plan unlocks solar irradiance, wind@100m, pollen history, and evapotranspiration.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.description: Date on or after 2010-01-01 in yyyy-MM-dd format.

parameters.name: end_dt
parameters.description: End date for range (Pro+ and above). Max 30 days range. yyyy-MM-dd.

get.description: Returns government weather alerts and warnings (USA, UK, Europe, rest of world) for a given location, if available.
Returns marine and sailing weather forecast (up to 7 days depending on plan) including tide data (Pro+ and above), wave height, swell, and water temperature.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of forecast days (1–7 depending on plan).

get.description: Returns 3-hourly weather forecast for a date between 14 days and 300 days in the future. Available on Pro+ plan and above.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.description: Date between 14 and 300 days from today in yyyy-MM-dd format.

get.description: Returns an hourly and daily power and energy forecast for a solar PV system (up to 14 days; hourly to day 5, 3-hourly after). Available on Business plan and above; keys on other plans get 403 / error 2009. Invalid parameters return 400 with error 1010 (capacity_kw) or 1011 (other solar parameters).

parameters.name: capacity_kw
parameters.description: Array (DC) size in kWp. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: tilt
parameters.description: Panel tilt in degrees from horizontal. Default: absolute latitude.

parameters.name: azimuth
parameters.description: Panel azimuth in degrees clockwise from north (180 = south). Default 180 in the northern hemisphere, 0 in the southern.

parameters.name: module_type
parameters.description: Module type (sets temperature coefficient). Default standard.

parameters.name: inverter_kw
parameters.description: Inverter AC rating in kW. Default capacity_kw / 1.2.

get.description: Returns matching cities and towns as an array of Location objects. Useful for building autocomplete location pickers.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial city name, postcode, or coordinates to search.

get.description: Returns geolocation and timezone data for a given IPv4 or IPv6 address. Pass `auto:ip` to auto-detect the caller's IP.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: IPv4, IPv6 address, or `auto:ip` for caller's IP.

get.description: Returns the local time and timezone information for a given location.
Returns sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, moon phase, and moon illumination for a given location and date.
Returns upcoming sports events for football (soccer), cricket, and golf. Historical sports data available on Enterprise plan.

ApiKeyAuth.name: key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key obtained from https://www.weatherapi.com/my/. Pass as `?key=YOUR_API_KEY` query parameter.

q.name: q
q.description: Location query. Accepts: city name, lat/lon, US zip, UK postcode, Canada postal code, METAR code (metar:EGLL), IATA (iata:DXB), auto:ip, IPv4/IPv6, or location ID (id:2801268).

dt.name: dt
dt.description: Restrict date output in yyyy-MM-dd format.

unixdt.name: unixdt
unixdt.description: Unix timestamp equivalent of `dt`. Do not pass both.

unixend_dt.name: unixend_dt
unixend_dt.description: Unix timestamp equivalent of `end_dt`. Do not pass both.

hour.name: hour
hour.description: Restrict output to a specific hour (0–23) in 24-hour format.

alerts.name: alerts
alerts.description: Include weather alerts in Forecast API response.

aqi.name: aqi
aqi.description: Include Air Quality Index (AQI) data in response.

pollen.name: pollen
pollen.description: Include pollen data. Available on Pro+ and above.

tp.name: tp
tp.description: Interval for data. Use tp=15 for 15-minute intervals (Enterprise only).

lang.name: lang
lang.description: Language code for condition text. E.g.: fr, de, es, zh, ar. See full list in docs.

current_fields.name: current_fields
current_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return in the current element, e.g. temp_c,wind_mph.

day_fields.name: day_fields
day_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return in forecast/history day element.

hour_fields.name: hour_fields
hour_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return in forecast/history hour element.

solar.name: solar
solar.description: Include solar irradiance data in History API. Enterprise only.

et0.name: et0
et0.description: Include evapotranspiration data. Business and Enterprise only.

wind100mph.name: wind100mph
wind100mph.description: Include wind speed at 100m height in mph. Enterprise only.

wind100kph.name: wind100kph
wind100kph.description: Include wind speed at 100m height in kph. Enterprise only.

Location.description: Location metadata returned with every weather response.

AirQuality.description: Air quality data. Returned when aqi=yes.

Pollen.description: Pollen data in grains/m³. Returned when pollen=yes (Pro+ and above).

q.description: Location query (same formats as q parameter)

custom_id.description: Optional identifier echoed back in response

SolarSystem.description: Settings used for the calculation, including any defaults applied.

azimuth.description: Panel azimuth in degrees clockwise from north (180 = south)

energy_kwh.description: Total AC energy for the day kWh

energy_dc_kwh.description: Total DC energy for the day kWh

peak_sun_hours.description: Equivalent full-sun hours on the panel plane

time.description: Period end, local time yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm

period_hours.description: Period length in hours (1 to day 5, 3 after)

angle_of_incidence.description: Angle of incidence on the panel degrees

energy_kwh.description: AC energy for the period kWh

clipped_kwh.description: Energy lost to inverter clipping kWh

BadRequest.description: Bad request — invalid parameter or location not found.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — API key missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden — API key quota exceeded, disabled, or plan does not include this resource.
